name: PARDUS Spark RS custom build
why_interesting: Current exact Spark RS factory pages and regional builds now define price and weight references around the retained custom owner build, while its exact frame generation and selected components remain unbound.
missing: Map the custom post frame generation, color and serial identity to one official Spark RS page
Exact custom-build complete weight, transaction price and selected factory-versus-owner BOM
Controlled exact-generation frame-stiffness magnitude and reproducible protocol
Current mainland dealer stock and exact-generation warranty terms

facts.drivetrain: Custom build: Shimano 105 mechanical with R8170 crank/chain upgrade
facts.frame_material: Generation conflict: the community lead reports T800, while the current official Spark RS classic page specifies HS-EPS+ carbon and an HS-HPT carbon fork; the custom bike is not mapped to that generation
facts.frame_construction: The current official classic platform uses fully hidden routing, an integrated carbon cockpit and asymmetric stays, but these details are not transferred to the unresolved white custom build
facts.current_factory_reference: Classic Spark RS page: HS-EPS+ frame, HS-HPT fork, M-BRONZE HB24 cockpit and Shimano 105 R7120 mechanical 2x12; not serial-mapped to the custom bike
facts.current_factory_price_reference: A 2026-08-30 official-store index displayed CNY 11,999 for a Spark RS 105 Di2 24-speed factory build. A 2026-09-24 index recheck now reports a CNY 11,499 low for a product card titled size-XL 105 Di2, but exposes several size and groupset options without mapping the low to a selected option. Neither observation establishes the custom owner-build price.
facts.complete_weight_references: Approximately 8.5 kg size M with alloy wheels, 8.0 kg size M with carbon wheels and 7.8 kg for a regional Rival/carbon build; custom build weight unresolved
facts.fitted_tire_references: Current official Spark RS factory builds show 25C or 28C fitted tires; no manufacturer maximum was found
facts.frame_stiffness_status: Manufacturer supplies only qualitative pedaling-stiffness and wind-tunnel context; no numeric reproducible exact-generation protocol was found and the custom generation remains unresolved
facts.support_route: PARDUS China customer-service contact page and dealer locator; exact-generation warranty duration and claim eligibility remain unverified

source_note: Current standard Spark RS Rival eTap AXS manufacturer page exposes buy/store-search links, but does not map the separately retained white custom build to that SKU, route, stock or checkout. The latest official-store index reports a CNY 11,499 low on an ambiguously selected size-XL 105 Di2 product card; that stock configuration is not the custom mechanical-105 build with R8170 upgrades and is not assigned as its price. The exact-generation warranty and maximum tire clearance remain unresolved.
price_status: A current official-store index reports a CNY 11,499 low for a stock 105 Di2 listing but does not map the amount to a selected option or the retained custom mechanical-105 build. No price is assigned to the custom candidate.
